_meta.status: ENGINEERING ADDITIONS to copy.json. Not in the Claude Design export. Every key here needs design review, and every key in _draft needs clinician sign-off. Pidgin needs native-speaker review.
_meta.why: The engine needs a few messages the design did not cover: diagnosis refusal, voice fallback, no-service-found, demo-data tag and a parameterised 'I heard' line.

en.diagnosis:
I can't tell whether you have HIV or another infection. Only a test, with a health worker, can tell you that.

A free, youth-friendly service can test you privately. Want me to find one?
en.voice_unavailable: Sorry, I can't listen to voice notes in this language yet. Please type your question and I'll answer in text.
en.referral_none: I don't have a checked service for that area yet. Please try another area nearby, or type MENU.
en.referral_demo_tag: DEMO DATA – not a real service. Do not visit.
en.referral_no_more: That's all the places I have for that area right now.
en.injection: I can only help with health, relationships and staying safe from HIV. What would you like to know?
en.reminder_unavailable: Sorry, I can't set reminders right now. You can come back and say Hi anytime.
en.kb_unreviewed: Note: this answer is draft and has not yet been checked by a health worker.
en.fu_later_ok: Okay, I'll check in once more in a few days.
en.closed: This chat has ended. Say Hi anytime to start again.
